source: North Sydney Council car parks directory + City of Sydney ArcGIS "Council car parks". Free periods, fees and hours are quoted from each council's own page; City of Sydney publishes no rates.

carParks.name: Goulburn Street Car Park
carParks.address: Corner of Goulburn & Elizabeth Streets, Haymarket

carParks.name: Alexander Street car park, Crows Nest
carParks.openingHours: 24 hours, 7 days a week. Paid parking hours between 7am and 11pm.
carParks.feesText:
• Free two-hours parking is available for one period per day.
• The third hour costs $9, then $7 per half hour after that.
• Maximum daily fee is $58.
Early bird parking
Early bird $22-a-day parking is available Monday to Friday on Level 4 (the rooftop) and is subject to availability.
You must enter the early bird area between 6.30am and 9.30am, and exit the early bird area between 2.30pm and 6.30pm.
Late entry or early exit from the early bird area will result in normal casual parking rates.
carParks.evCharging:
On level P3:
Four dual chargers (eight charging bays; one dual 360kW, three dual 180kW) operated by NRMA . For support, please call NRMA on 1300 233 544.
On level P1:
• Two EV chargers (22kW) operated by ChargePost . Bring your own charging cable. For support, contact ChargePost on 02 6171 6108 or info@chargepost.com.au

carParks.name: Barry Street car park, Neutral Bay
carParks.restrictionsText:
Two hours free parking is available:
• Monday to Friday - 8.30am to 6pm
• Saturdays - 8.30am to 12.30pm.
All other hours are unrestricted.

carParks.name: Council parking for visitors
carParks.restrictionsText:
Free parking for one hour is available to Council visitors:
• Monday to Friday, between 8am and 7pm.
​​Parking is unrestricted outside of these hours, except on the first and third Friday and Saturday of the month when the following applies:
• no parking from 10pm on Fridays
• no parking until 3pm on Saturdays.
If you need parking for a longer period, paid parking is available on nearby streets and in Ridge Street car park .
carParks.evCharging: Two dual 22kW AC chargers (four charging bays) operated by ChargePost . Bring your own charging cable. For support, contact ChargePost on 02 6171 6108 or info@chargepost.com.au

carParks.name: Grosvenor Lane car park, Neutral Bay
carParks.restrictionsText:
Free 90-minute parking is available:
• Monday to Friday - 8am to 6pm
• Saturday - 8am to 8pm
• Sunday - 8am to 5pm.
All other hours are unrestricted.

carParks.name: Holtermann Street car park, Crows Nest
carParks.openingHours: 24 hours, 7 days a week. Paid parking hours between 7am and 11pm, Monday to Saturday.
carParks.feesText:
Monday to Saturday:
• Free two-hours parking is available for one period per day.
• The third hour costs $8.50, then $6.40 per half hour after that.
• Maximum daily fee $58.
Parking is free all day Sunday.
Early bird parking
Early bird $20-a-day parking is available Monday to Friday on the rooftop levels and is subject to availability.
You must enter the Early Bird area between 6.30am and 9.30am, and exit between 2.30pm and 6.30pm.
Late entry or early exit will result in normal casual parking rates.
carParks.evCharging: 13 dual 22kW AC chargers (26 charging bays) on levels P2 and above operated by ChargePost . Bring your own charging cable. For support, contact ChargePost on 02 6171 6108 or info@chargepost.com.au

carParks.name: Hume Street car park, Crows Nest
carParks.openingHours: 24 hours, 7 days a week. Paid parking hours between 7am and 11pm, Monday to Saturday.
carParks.feesText:
Monday to Saturday:
• Two-hours of free parking is available for one period per day.
• The third hour costs $8, then $7.20 per half hour onwards.
• Maximum daily fee, from 7am to 6pm, is $58.
Evening parking:
• Entry after 4pm receives free parking until 6pm.
• Exit after 6pm will incur a flat rate evening fee of $12.
Free parking is available all day Sunday.
Early bird parking
Early bird $20-a-day parking is available Monday to Friday on level 4 and is subject to availability.
You must enter the early bird area between 6.30am and 9.30am, and exit the early bird area between 2.30pm and 6.30pm.
Late entry or early exit from the early bird area will result in normal casual parking rates.
Saturday early bird $20-a-day parking is available on level 4 and is subject to availability.
You must enter the early bird area between 6.30am and 12pm, and exit before 1am.
Late entry or early exit from the early bird area will result in normal casual parking rates.
carParks.evCharging:
On level P2:
• Two dual 75kW DC fast chargers (four charging bays) operated by Evie . For support, contact Evie on 1300 463 843.
• Two single 22kW AC chargers (bring your own charging cable) operated by Council.

carParks.name: Nicholson Street car park, Crows Nest

carParks.name: Ridge Street car park, North Sydney
carParks.openingHours: 24 hours, 7 days a week. Paid parking hours between 7am and 11pm, Monday to Friday.
carParks.residentsOnlyNote: Free 90-minutes parking for residents Monday to Friday, residents only. To register, apply for a resident vehicle permit .
carParks.feesText:
Monday to Friday:
• First hour is $10.20, then $7.80 per half hour after that.
• Maximum daily fee until 6pm is $72.50.
• Evening flat rate after 6pm is $12.90.
Parking is free all day Saturday and Sunday.
Early bird parking
Early bird $37.40-a-day parking is available Monday to Friday, subject to availability and must be validated at the pay machine after entry. You must enter the car park between 6.30am and 9.30am, and exit between 2.30pm and 6.30pm.
Late entry or early exit will result in normal casual parking rates.
Free 90-minutes parking for residents
Monday to Friday, residents only. To register, apply for a resident vehicle permit .
carParks.evCharging: Two dual 75kW DC fast chargers (four charging bays) on ground level operated by Evie . For support, contact Evie on 1300 463 843.

carParks.name: Ward Street car park, North Sydney
carParks.feesText:
Monday to Friday:
• First hour is $11, then $8 per half hour after that.
• Maximum daily fee, from 7am to 6pm, is $75.
• Evening flat rate after 6pm is $13.
Weekend flat rate is $13 per day.
Early bird parking
Early bird parking is available Monday to Friday, subject to availability.
• Early bird undercover: $33 – past ramp on level 3 only.
• Early bird rooftop: $27 – on rooftop only.
You must enter the early bird area between 5am and 9.30am, and exit the early bird area between 2.30pm and 6.30pm.
Late entry or early exit from the early bird area will result in normal casual parking rates.
Please note, limited spaces are available for early bird parking. Once all available early bird parking spaces are taken, registrations cannot be validated for the early bird rate.
carParks.accessibleSpaces: Six spaces - please note, the car park is not wheelchair accessible.
carParks.evCharging: Two single 22kW AC chargers operated by ChargePost . Bring your own charging cable. For support, contact ChargePost on 02 6171 6108 or info@chargepost.com.au
